title: Bipol: Multi-axes Evaluation of Bias with Explainability in Benchmark Datasets
measurement_description: The paper measured the presence of religious bias as one of several axes (e.g., gender, race) in NLP benchmark datasets using a metric called bipol. The measurement involved classifying text samples as biased or unbiased and analyzing the frequency of terms from a religious lexicon in the biased samples.
findings: The paper found that the Boolq dataset contains religious bias, as identified by the bipol metric and its associated dictionaries of lists. However, the specific nature or extent of this religious bias was not detailed in the paper.
